note: The declared endpoints of conformance/harness.ts, executed by each language runtime's OWN bc-generated module against live PostgreSQL + MySQL. Every expected field is the one the TS leg captured from the same declaration on the same server (conformance/vectors/exec.json) — a language leg is byte-compared against the TS reference, statements and full nested result alike.
